rationale: Declare the archive digest and byte size with the asset and pass a DumpSourceConfiguration into the planner, so the plan records them. Verify a fetched archive, write a per-table cache marker, and use the marker to decide whether a cache is current. Delete the global dump manifest and the unused pharos319-chdb cache, and put chdb in the main dependencies so a cold data directory rebuilds with kbs run.
subject: pharos_kg/modules/dump_source.py
title: Make the dump cache self-describing and rebuildable
